# landing

The homepage, at bare `/website` — two bands and nothing else.

[`intro`](plugins/intro/CLAUDE.md) states what equin is and why there are two
questions; [`fork`](plugins/fork/CLAUDE.md) asks them, as two click targets into
[`questions/`](../questions/CLAUDE.md). The page ends there on purpose: no
call-to-action band, because there is nothing to download or sign up for.

The homepage is also the one website pane that wears NO header — see
`shell/web/panes.tsx` — so these two bands are the only thing on it.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Landing-page sections of the public website: the intro, and the fork into the two questions.
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`fork`** — Landing fork band: the homepage's two questions as two side-by-side click targets, each opening its own answer page.
  - **`intro`** — Landing intro band: the two opening paragraphs of the equin site — what equin is, and why the page forks into two questions.
